events.title: Every Day Counts: day targets, a Cup fix, and progress that sticks
events.summary: Next Fest players told us the middle of the week dragged. So every day now has its own target. New Day targets. Every day except Friday has its own target. Bank it by the bell and Vic's desk adds a bonus. Miss it and nothing happens: the week is still what passes or fails. This week's edges. The week's result and the lose screen now show how often each of your cards fired, and for a card that never did, what it kept missing. Losing still moves you forward. events.summary: The demo has been live for two days, and the trading floor had notes. This patch adds the classics. Average Down. A new edge card. events.title: The HOPIATE demo is live for Steam Next Fest
events.summary: HOPIATE is a roguelike deckbuilder with a simulated market instead of a board, and its free demo is in Steam Next Fest from October 19 to 26. DEGEN TRADING funds you $1,500 and five days. Trade the week, clear the target, spend the profit on cards that make the next week pay more. Blow the account and you start again with nothing.
